title: REQ · Game actions emit playAnimation interact so the boy plays the interact animation
summary: App emits playAnimation {target:'boy', name:'interact'} on every action
description: Context: App passes game.act directly to ObjectOverlay.onAction, so reactToPhaser.playAnimation is never emitted although BootScene handles it. Desired: wrapped handler runs the action then emits playAnimation for the boy. Why: carry-over behaviour 3.9.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object action is chosen, when onAction fires, then reactToPhaser emits playAnimation with target boy and name interact
Given the action, when it runs, then game state still updates through game.act
